title: Cache TTL Validator Mixing Wall-Clock Sources
root_cause: Cache computes entry age as time.time() - os.path.getmtime(). Under clock_shift, time.time() is monkey-patched +3600s but getmtime() returns real OS time. Mismatch makes entries appear 3600s old immediately, exceeding TTL.

naive_quick_fix.description: Increases TTL to 4000s to exceed the 3600s clock shift. Passes this specific shift but fragile to larger shifts.

certified_real_fix.description: Uses time.monotonic() for age tracking instead of mixing time.time() with os.path.getmtime(). Immune to any clock shift.
